Watchog

Normal

Unova · Generation 5

Watchog is a Normal-type Lookout Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 27 kg. It evolves from Patrat. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 420.
